images.title: Zainab's colouring time
images.purpose: Show the time from 04:25 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. as two easy hops on a time line: 35 minutes up to 05:00 p.m., then 10 minutes more, 45 minutes in all.
images.composition: A caption at the top, a time line with two curved hops above it, three labelled times under it, and the total written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LEFT: the caption Zainab started colouring at 04:25 p.m. and stopped at 05:10 p.m. in dark #1F2937 sans-serif bold (36 px), left edge at x 100, about y 70. TIME LINE: one thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal line (5 px) at y 430 from x 170 to x 1250, with exactly 10 vertical tick marks, one every 120 px (5 minutes) from x 170 to x 1250, at x 170, 290, 410, 530, 650, 770, 890, 1010, 1130 and 1250. 3 tall ticks (44 px) at x 170, 1010 and 1250 and 7 short ticks (24 px) at the other seven places. A round dot (24 px across) sits on the line on each tall tick: teal #0072B2 at x 170, grey #6B7280 at x 1010, amber #E69F00 at x 1250. Under the line, centred under the three tall ticks at about y 505, the three time labels 04:25 p.m. (x 170), 05:00 p.m. (x 1010) and 05:10 p.m. (x 1250) in dark #1F2937 bold (38 px). The short ticks have no labels. HOPS: exactly 2 curved arrows above the line, each a smooth curved arc (the top of an ellipse) with its arrowhead at the right end, pointing down onto the line. Hop 1 is teal #0072B2 (6 px), from x 170 to x 1010 (840 px wide) and 100 px high, with the label 35 minutes centred above it at x 590, about y 295 (40 px, bold, dark). Hop 2 is amber #E69F00 (6 px), from x 1010 to x 1250 (240 px wide, 70 px high), with the label 10 minutes centred above it at x 1130, about y 325 (40 px, bold, dark). BRACKET: one thin grey #6B7280 bracket line (4 px) at y 565 from x 170 to x 1250, with a short 20 px upright end at each end pointing up. Centred under the bracket at x 710 and about y 645, one line of bold dark text, 45 minutes in all (64 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Zainab started colouring at 04:25 p.m. and stopped at 05:10 p.m.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 10 tick marks, 2 hop arrows or 3 dots
hops whose widths are not in proportion to their minutes: the 35 minutes hop is 840 px wide and the 10 minutes hop is 240 px wide
images.takeaway: From 04:25 p.m. up to 05:00 p.m. is 35 minutes and from 05:00 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. is 10 minutes, so the time is 45 minutes in all.
images.description: A time line from 04:25 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. with a hop of 35 minutes up to 05:00 p.m. and a hop of 10 minutes to 05:10 p.m., and 45 minutes in all written below.
images.context: Concept image for Time Elapsed Between Two Times. It follows the idea of the figures in your maths book (the time between two clock times found by hopping up to the next whole hour) and shows the concept's own example of Zainab colouring.
images.teaching_notes: Let the child say the hops aloud: up to the next whole hour first, then the rest. The slip to watch: treating an hour as 100 minutes, so that 04:25 p.m. to 05:00 p.m. is counted as 75 minutes.

image_decisions.why: The time line with a hop up to the next whole hour and a hop for the rest shows the counting strategy the concept teaches.
